correctness.rationale: The exact antichain vertex set is given by two coordinate cubes meeting at the origin. A positive probability design with per-subset weights binom(m+1,k)/binom(2m+1,m) has mean t*1 and covariance Q/(2m). Projector algebra proves an exact ellipsoid boundary identity for every vertex and every m>=1. For any containing ellipsoid (center a, positive shape S), taking design expectations gives tr(S^{-1}Q)/(2m)+(a-t1)^T S^{-1}(a-t1)<=1; determinant AM-GM proves det S>=det Q and equality forces center and shape uniqueness. All coefficients are positive for m>=1. Exact rational standalone script in the actual package verified contact and moments for m=1..8 and is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The Löwner ellipsoid is a canonical affine-geometric invariant of natural poset polytopes. The theorem gives its unique center, three exact squared-semiaxis classes, exact volume, and a full contact classification for an infinite family; the explicit positive binomial/hypergeometric measure is a structural certificate rather than a computational fit. Although the number of vertices grows exponentially, all remain contacts, while anisotropy grows linearly as 2m+1. These are non-implied geometric facts useful for metric comparisons of chain/order polytopes, not mere normalizations or generic exercises.
